external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A library member using the library app or a self-service kiosk.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk staff who use the circulation page to manage member accounts and loans.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand

processes.name: library app
processes.description: The app on a member's phone used to borrow, renew and reserve books.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: self-service kiosk
processes.description: A branch kiosk where members scan their library card and books being borrowed or returned.
processes.source_excerpt: Every branch has self-service kiosks where a member scans their library card and the books they are borrowing or returning.

processes.name: lending API
processes.description: The REST service through which loans are accessed and changed.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: Priya said, "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look." She also said she could not tell what it accepts or does with a call it does not like.

data_stores.name: loans database
data_stores.description: The single database containing members, loans and reservations, including member contact details and borrowing history.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.

data_flows.name: use lending app
data_flows.description: A member uses the library app to borrow, renew or reserve books.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
data_flows.data_description: Borrowing, renewal and reservation requests involving a member and a book or title.

data_flows.name: change loan
data_flows.description: The library app calls the lending API to renew loans, reserve titles and submit borrowing requests.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.notes: Authentication is uncertain: Priya said, "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look."
data_flows.data_description: The member, book or title, and requested loan or reservation change.

data_flows.name: scan library card and books
data_flows.description: A member scans their library card and books at a self-service kiosk.
data_flows.source_excerpt: a member scans their library card and the books they are borrowing or returning
data_flows.data_description: A library card and books being borrowed or returned.

data_flows.name: send loan and return
data_flows.description: The kiosks send loan and return transactions to the lending API as items are scanned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.
data_flows.notes: Priya could not say what the kiosks talk to beyond what arrives at the API.
data_flows.data_description: Loan and return transactions, including the member and scanned books.

data_flows.name: change loan records
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to extend loans, clear account blocks and mark books returned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login. The history records that a loan was closed by hand but does not identify the person or branch.
data_flows.data_description: Loan and member-account changes made by desk staff.

data_flows.name: read and write loans
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Members, loans, reservations, member contact details and borrowing history.

trust_boundaries.name: internet
trust_boundaries.description: The internet through which phones reach the lending API.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet.

trust_boundaries.name: branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network used by branch kiosks and desk staff.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data-centre environment where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.
